name: Publishing Workflow
bpmn:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn2:definitions xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:bpmn2="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" xmlns:sling="http://sling.apache.org/bpmn" id="Definitions_publishingWorkflow" targetNamespace="http://sling.apache.org/workflow">
  <bpmn2:process id="publishingWorkflow" name="Publishing Workflow" isExecutable="true">
    <bpmn2:startEvent id="StartEvent_1" name="Publish Request">
      <bpmn2:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn2:outgoing>
    </bpmn2:startEvent>
    <bpmn2:serviceTask id="Task_ValidateContent" name="Validate Content">
      <bpmn2:extensionElements>
        <delegateClass>org.apache.sling.cms.workflow.delegates.ValidateContentDelegate</delegateClass>
      </bpmn2:extensionElements>
      <bpmn2:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn2:incoming>
      <bpmn2:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn2:outgoing>
    </bpmn2:serviceTask>
    <bpmn2:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_IsValid" name="Is Valid?">
      <bpmn2:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn2:incoming>
      <bpmn2:outgoing>Flow_Valid</bpmn2:outgoing>
      <bpmn2:outgoing>Flow_Invalid</bpmn2:outgoing>
    </bpmn2:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn2:userTask id="Task_EditorApproval" name="Editor Approval">
      <bpmn2:extensionElements>
        <sling:candidateGroup>editors</sling:candidateGroup>
        <sling:formKey>editor-approval-form</sling:formKey>
        <sling:priority>80</sling:priority>
      </bpmn2:extensionElements>
      <bpmn2:incoming>Flow_Valid</bpmn2:incoming>
      <bpmn2:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn2:outgoing>
    </bpmn2:userTask>
    <bpmn2:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_EditorDecision" name="Approved?">
      <bpmn2:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn2:incoming>
      <bpmn2:outgoing>Flow_EditorApproved</bpmn2:outgoing>
      <bpmn2:outgoing>Flow_EditorRejected</bpmn2:outgoing>
    </bpmn2:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn2:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelStart">
      <bpmn2:incoming>Flow_EditorApproved</bpmn2:incoming>
      <bpmn2:outgoing>Flow_ToStaging</bpmn2:outgoing>
      <bpmn2:outgoing>Flow_ToNotify</bpmn2:outgoing>
      <bpmn2:outgoing>Flow_ToIndex</bpmn2:outgoing>
    </bpmn2:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn2:serviceTask id="Task_PublishStaging" name="Publish to Staging">
      <bpmn2:extensionElements>
        <delegateClass>org.apache.sling.cms.workflow.delegates.PublishDelegate</delegateClass>
        <sling:field name="targetPath" value="/content/staging" />
        <sling:field name="replicationAction" value="activate" />
      </bpmn2:extensionElements>
      <bpmn2:incoming>Flow_ToStaging</bpmn2:incoming>
      <bpmn2:outgoing>Flow_StagingDone</bpmn2:outgoing>
    </bpmn2:serviceTask>
    <bpmn2:serviceTask id="Task_UpdateIndex" name="Update Search Index">
      <bpmn2:extensionElements>
        <delegateClass>org.apache.sling.cms.workflow.delegates.IndexDelegate</delegateClass>
      </bpmn2:extensionElements>
      <bpmn2:incoming>Flow_ToIndex</bpmn2:incoming>
      <bpmn2:outgoing>Flow_IndexDone</bpmn2:outgoing>
    </bpmn2:serviceTask>
    <bpmn2:serviceTask id="Task_NotifySubscribers" name="Notify Subscribers">
      <bpmn2:extensionElements>
        <delegateClass>org.apache.sling.cms.workflow.delegates.SendEmailDelegate</delegateClass>
        <sling:field name="template" value="/etc/workflow/email-templates/publication" />
      </bpmn2:extensionElements>
      <bpmn2:incoming>Flow_ToNotify</bpmn2:incoming>
      <bpmn2:outgoing>Flow_NotifyDone</bpmn2:outgoing>
    </bpmn2:serviceTask>
    <bpmn2:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelEnd">
      <bpmn2:incoming>Flow_StagingDone</bpmn2:incoming>
      <bpmn2:incoming>Flow_IndexDone</bpmn2:incoming>
      <bpmn2:incoming>Flow_NotifyDone</bpmn2:incoming>
      <bpmn2:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn2:outgoing>
    </bpmn2:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn2:userTask id="Task_ProductionApproval" name="Production Approval">
      <bpmn2:extensionElements>
        <sling:candidateGroup>administrators</sling:candidateGroup>
        <sling:formKey>production-approval-form</sling:formKey>
        <sling:priority>100</sling:priority>
      </bpmn2:extensionElements>
      <bpmn2:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn2:incoming>
      <bpmn2:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn2:outgoing>
    </bpmn2:userTask>
    <bpmn2:serviceTask id="Task_PublishProduction" name="Publish to Production">
      <bpmn2:extensionElements>
        <delegateClass>org.apache.sling.cms.workflow.delegates.PublishDelegate</delegateClass>
        <sling:field name="targetPath" value="/content/production" />
        <sling:field name="replicationAction" value="activate" />
      </bpmn2:extensionElements>
      <bpmn2:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn2:incoming>
      <bpmn2:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn2:outgoing>
    </bpmn2:serviceTask>
    <bpmn2:serviceTask id="Task_NotifyInvalid" name="Notify - Invalid Content">
      <bpmn2:extensionElements>
        <delegateClass>org.apache.sling.cms.workflow.delegates.SendEmailDelegate</delegateClass>
        <sling:field name="template" value="/etc/workflow/email-templates/invalid" />
      </bpmn2:extensionElements>
      <bpmn2:incoming>Flow_Invalid</bpmn2:incoming>
      <bpmn2:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn2:outgoing>
    </bpmn2:serviceTask>
    <bpmn2:serviceTask id="Task_NotifyRejected" name="Notify - Rejected">
      <bpmn2:extensionElements>
        <delegateClass>org.apache.sling.cms.workflow.delegates.SendEmailDelegate</delegateClass>
        <sling:field name="template" value="/etc/workflow/email-templates/rejection" />
      </bpmn2:extensionElements>
      <bpmn2:incoming>Flow_EditorRejected</bpmn2:incoming>
      <bpmn2:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn2:outgoing>
    </bpmn2:serviceTask>
    <bpmn2:endEvent id="EndEvent_Published" name="Content Published">
      <bpmn2:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn2:incoming>
    </bpmn2:endEvent>
    <bpmn2:endEvent id="EndEvent_Invalid" name="Validation Failed">
      <bpmn2:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn2:incoming>
    </bpmn2:endEvent>
    <bpmn2:endEvent id="EndEvent_Rejected" name="Rejected">
      <bpmn2:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn2:incoming>
    </bpmn2:endEvent>
    <bpmn2:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_1" targetRef="Task_ValidateContent" />
    <bpmn2:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_ValidateContent" targetRef="Gateway_IsValid" />
    <bpmn2:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Valid" name="Valid" sourceRef="Gateway_IsValid" targetRef="Task_EditorApproval">
      <bpmn2:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn2:tFormalExpression">${isValid == true}</bpmn2:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn2:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn2:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Invalid" name="Invalid" sourceRef="Gateway_IsValid" targetRef="Task_NotifyInvalid">
      <bpmn2:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn2:tFormalExpression">${isValid == false}</bpmn2:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn2:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn2:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_EditorApproval" targetRef="Gateway_EditorDecision" />
    <bpmn2:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EditorApproved" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_EditorDecision" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelStart">
      <bpmn2:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn2:tFormalExpression">${approved == true}</bpmn2:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn2:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn2:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EditorRejected" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_EditorDecision" targetRef="Task_NotifyRejected">
      <bpmn2:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn2:tFormalExpression">${approved == false}</bpmn2:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn2:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn2:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToStaging" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelStart" targetRef="Task_PublishStaging" />
    <bpmn2:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToNotify" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelStart" targetRef="Task_NotifySubscribers" />
    <bpmn2:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToIndex" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelStart" targetRef="Task_UpdateIndex" />
    <bpmn2:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StagingDone" sourceRef="Task_PublishStaging" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelEnd" />
    <bpmn2:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IndexDone" sourceRef="Task_UpdateIndex" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelEnd" />
    <bpmn2:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotifyDone" sourceRef="Task_NotifySubscribers" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelEnd" />
    <bpmn2:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelEnd" targetRef="Task_ProductionApproval" />
    <bpmn2:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_ProductionApproval" targetRef="Task_PublishProduction" />
    <bpmn2:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_PublishProduction" targetRef="EndEvent_Published" />
    <bpmn2:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_NotifyInvalid" targetRef="EndEvent_Invalid" />
    <bpmn2:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_NotifyRejected" targetRef="EndEvent_Rejected" />
  </bpmn2:process>
  <bpmndi:BPMNDiagram id="BPMNDiagram_1">

      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="StartEvent_1_di" bpmnElement="StartEvent_1">
